name: ggml
description: Tensor library for machine learning (tetherto/qvac-ext-ggml @ 2026-01-30, pinned at 05afdc59 — merge of PR #6). Carries on top of upstream ggml master: the Wan-required Metal ops (IM2COL_3D, PAD left-padding) with a tightened IM2COL_3D supports_op, plus the hybrid static-CPU / dynamic-GPU backend packaging (GGML_CPU_STATIC, GGML_MAX_NAME prop, graceful no-OpenCL-device fallback, public ggml-opencl.h install). Local overlay; bumped port-version forces this over the registry. Drop once the registry baseline catches up to a ggml-org/ggml ref containing this work.
